description.en: A fern stem specimen preserves a thick outer cortex with petiole, root and scale features.
description.zh: 蕨类茎标本保存厚外皮层及叶柄、根和鳞片特征。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Weichselia reticulata, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Weichselia reticulata 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: A cortex-dominated stem exterior differs from Tempskya's multiple-stem interior and Psaronius's root mantle.
distinctness.zh: 以厚皮层为主的茎表区别于Tempskya多茎内部和Psaronius根套。

modeling_brief.en: Use a short upright specimen with raised attachment bosses and a restrained cut face; do not attach a guessed crown.
modeling_brief.zh: 制作带突起着生座及简约切面的短直立标本，不拼接猜测叶冠。

uncertainty: Complete growth habit is disputed; this entry deliberately remains a stem specimen.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: New insights into Weichselia reticulata through anatomically preserved stems
sources.supports: Stem cortex, scales, petiole and root features of Weichselia.
